newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - FINNISH Q1 GDP GROWTH SEEN AT 5.2 PCT.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - FINNISH Q1 GDP GROWTH SEEN AT 5.2 PCT.

text.p: Finnish gross domestic product growth is forecast to have slowed to 5.2 percent year-on-year in the first quarter of 1997 from 5.8 percent in Q4, 1996, according to a Reuters poll of economists.
The median of 10 economists' forecasts for the market-price based quarterly GDP figure was for growth of 5.2 percent (mean 5.12 percent) in a range from 4.5 percent to 5.5 percent.
Statistics Finland (SF) is scheduled to release Q1 GDP data on Tuesday at 0700/0400 GMT.
The mean of SF's monthly producer-price-based GDP growth figures for January, February and March is 5.43 percent.
The economists were polled by telephone on Monday afternoon.
Contributors to the survey were Alfred Berg, Evli, Handelsbanken, Interbank, Merita, OKOBANK, Postipankki, Protos, S-E Banken and Unibank (Copenhagen).
